findings.source: YBSRegistry.sol:87-101 Factories memory _factories = factories; ... utils = _factories.utilities.deploy(ybs, distributor); return (ybs, distributor, utils)
findings.issue: The third factory is read back from the memory copy of the struct (`mem[204 len 20]` instead of stor4), the address check and the returned `utils` are printed as slices (`ext_call.return_data[12 len 20]`, `Bytes(12, 0), ...`) although the same checks on the first call print `address(ext_call.return_data[0])`.
findings.rule: Forward a constant-address memory store to later reads (mem[192] = stor4, so mem[204 len 20] is address(stor4)); print `x[12 len 20]` of a word as `address(x)` and merge `Bytes(12, 0), addr` into one address word.
